flows.title: Codex: terminal setup
flows.summary: Add the marketplace using its Git repository URL. The app fetches the source; no manual clone is needed.
prerequisites: Install Codex and sign in before running skills. Use the official documentation if the application is not yet available.
Check the chosen plugin's requirements; some skills need additional tools or runtimes.
Use PowerShell on Windows or Bash/zsh on macOS/Linux. Interactive slash commands are entered inside the application.
Git and access to the configured repository are required. Registration can run from any directory; it fetches the source for you.

steps.title: Add Faye Plugin Market
paragraphs: Run this once for the selected source. If the same source is already registered, reuse it. Adding a marketplace makes its plugins available to choose; it does not install them all.
steps.expected: The source is registered. Its native marketplace identity is faye-plugin-market.

paragraphs: Install Faye Coding Assistant only if you want its skills. Review any permission or trust prompts shown by the application.
packages.expected: Faye Coding Assistant appears in the installed plugin list. Compare its version with 0.1.0-beta.7 shown by this marketplace.

paragraphs: Install Faye Image Utility only if you want its skills. Review any permission or trust prompts shown by the application.
packages.expected: Faye Image Utility appears in the installed plugin list. Compare its version with 0.1.0-beta.6 shown by this marketplace.

paragraphs: Install Faye UI System Engineer only if you want its skills. Review any permission or trust prompts shown by the application.
packages.expected: Faye UI System Engineer appears in the installed plugin list. Compare its version with 0.1.0-beta.4 shown by this marketplace.

start.title: Confirm installation and start a new session
paragraphs: Check the plugins you selected are installed and enabled where the application exposes that state. The list command below is a quick confirmation, not a test of every skill.

Start a new Codex session, open its skill picker or Plugins interface, and choose a task from the installed plugin's skill guides. Read that skill's inputs and requirements before sending your request.
Codex skill requests may use $skill-name. Copy the example from the selected skill's guide, including any explicit invocation it requires.
start.expected: Your selected plugins are installed and their applicable skills can be found or explicitly invoked in a fresh session.

management.title: Refresh the Git marketplace
paragraphs: Refresh the source when you want to check for new package versions. Compare installed versions afterward; refreshing the catalog alone is not evidence that each installed plugin was updated.
management.expected: The marketplace refresh succeeds; inspect the desired plugin's current and available version before changing its installation.

management.title: Enable or disable a plugin
paragraphs: Open /plugins inside Codex. Select an installed plugin and use the displayed enable/disable action. Disabling keeps the installation but makes its capabilities unavailable until enabled again.
management.expected: The plugin browser shows the intended enabled state.

management.title: Uninstall Faye Coding Assistant
paragraphs: Only use this when you intend to remove this plugin. It removes the selected installation and its capabilities; it is not a troubleshooting prerequisite. Leave other plugins and marketplace sources intact.
management.expected: Faye Coding Assistant is no longer listed as installed.

management.title: Uninstall Faye Image Utility
paragraphs: Only use this when you intend to remove this plugin. It removes the selected installation and its capabilities; it is not a troubleshooting prerequisite. Leave other plugins and marketplace sources intact.
management.expected: Faye Image Utility is no longer listed as installed.

management.title: Uninstall Faye UI System Engineer
paragraphs: Only use this when you intend to remove this plugin. It removes the selected installation and its capabilities; it is not a troubleshooting prerequisite. Leave other plugins and marketplace sources intact.
management.expected: Faye UI System Engineer is no longer listed as installed.

alternatives.title: Check an existing installation
paragraphs: Use this before adding a second source or when setup reports that the plugin already exists. Compare the names and source locations; reuse a matching installation.
alternatives.expected: The intended source and installed package are identified without removing other registrations.

verification.scope: Git syntax is documented and confirmed by CLI help. A complete Git installation has not been newly verified for this guide.

preparationChoices.title: Use an existing copy
paragraphs: Find the marketplace folder already on your computer. It contains plugins and the hidden .agents/plugins/marketplace.json registry. A plugin folder inside plugins is not the marketplace root.
Keep this copy in a stable location. Do not overwrite it or change its Git branch just to follow this guide.
preparationChoices.expected: You know the full path to the marketplace root.

preparationChoices.title: Clone the repository
paragraphs: Git must be installed. Run this from the parent folder where you want to keep the copy. faye-plugin-market is an example destination name; choose another unused name if needed.
If the destination already exists, use that copy or choose a different destination. Do not overwrite it. After cloning, use the full path to the new folder in the next step.
preparationChoices.expected: A new local copy exists in the chosen destination.

preparationChoices.title: Download and extract the repository
paragraphs: Open the repository: https://github.com/Fayegram-AI/plugin-market

Use its source archive download option, then extract the archive into a stable location. Open the extracted folder containing plugins and .agents/plugins/marketplace.json, not the archive or a surrounding downloads folder.
An extracted archive is a local copy without Git history; git pull cannot update it.
preparationChoices.expected: The extracted marketplace root is available on your computer.

prerequisites: Install Antigravity and sign in before running skills. Use the official documentation if the application is not yet available.

Use PowerShell on Windows or Bash/zsh on macOS/Linux. Interactive slash commands are entered inside the application.

steps.title: Open the marketplace folder
paragraphs: Replace the entire quoted example path below with the full path to your marketplace root. Keep the quotes, especially when the path contains spaces. Choose the command for your terminal shell.
All following relative paths use this folder. The single dot means this marketplace root; ./plugins/<plugin-id> means one plugin folder inside it.
steps.expected: Your terminal is in the folder containing plugins and .agents/plugins/marketplace.json.

commands.label: Open your local copy — replace the example path

paragraphs: Install Faye Coding Assistant only if you want its skills. Review any permission or trust prompts shown by the application.
packages.expected: Faye Coding Assistant appears in the installed plugin list. Compare its version with 0.1.0-beta.7 shown by this marketplace.

start.title: Confirm installation and start a new session
paragraphs: Check the plugins you selected are installed and enabled where the application exposes that state. The list command below is a quick confirmation, not a test of every skill.

Start a new Antigravity session, open its skill picker or Plugins interface, and choose a task from the installed plugin's skill guides. Read that skill's inputs and requirements before sending your request.
Use the product's native skill picker or slash-command guidance. Read the selected skill's guide rather than translating another application's example yourself.
start.expected: Your selected plugins are installed and their applicable skills can be found or explicitly invoked in a fresh session.

management.title: Update a local copy later
paragraphs: Updating the source is separate from installing a plugin. git pull updates an existing Git checkout; it does not create one and cannot update an extracted archive.

Before updating a checkout, check its branch and local changes. For an archive, obtain a newer copy separately and compare versions. Do not overwrite the existing folder or change an installed plugin without deciding to update it.
management.expected: You have identified the source and version you intend to use before making an update.

management.title: Manage an installed plugin
paragraphs: Open /plugins in an Antigravity CLI session and use the Installed tab to inspect or toggle a plugin. For a newer local copy, compare versions and use the documented installation procedure for that package after deciding to replace it.
management.expected: The Installed tab reflects the intended plugin and enabled state.

management.title: Uninstall Faye Coding Assistant
paragraphs: Only use this when you intend to remove this plugin. It removes the selected installation and its capabilities; it is not a troubleshooting prerequisite. Leave other plugins and marketplace sources intact.
management.expected: Faye Coding Assistant is no longer listed as installed.

management.title: Uninstall Faye Image Utility
paragraphs: Only use this when you intend to remove this plugin. It removes the selected installation and its capabilities; it is not a troubleshooting prerequisite. Leave other plugins and marketplace sources intact.

paragraphs: Only use this when you intend to remove this plugin. It removes the selected installation and its capabilities; it is not a troubleshooting prerequisite. Leave other plugins and marketplace sources intact.

alternatives.title: Check an existing installation
paragraphs: Use this before adding a second source or when setup reports that the plugin already exists. Compare the names and source locations; reuse a matching installation.
alternatives.expected: The intended source and installed package are identified without removing other registrations.

verification.scope: Local installation and one representative skill were checked on the recorded version. This does not certify every workflow, operating system, or app interface.

preparationChoices.title: Use an existing copy
paragraphs: Find the marketplace folder already on your computer. It contains plugins and the hidden .agents/plugins/marketplace.json registry. A plugin folder inside plugins is not the marketplace root.
Keep this copy in a stable location. Do not overwrite it or change its Git branch just to follow this guide.
preparationChoices.expected: You know the full path to the marketplace root.

preparationChoices.title: Clone the repository
paragraphs: Git must be installed. Run this from the parent folder where you want to keep the copy. faye-plugin-market is an example destination name; choose another unused name if needed.
If the destination already exists, use that copy or choose a different destination. Do not overwrite it. After cloning, use the full path to the new folder in the next step.
preparationChoices.expected: A new local copy exists in the chosen destination.

preparationChoices.title: Download and extract the repository
paragraphs: Open the repository: https://github.com/Fayegram-AI/plugin-market

Use its source archive download option, then extract the archive into a stable location. Open the extracted folder containing plugins and .agents/plugins/marketplace.json, not the archive or a surrounding downloads folder.
An extracted archive is a local copy without Git history; git pull cannot update it.
preparationChoices.expected: The extracted marketplace root is available on your computer.

agentRules: Identify the selected product, interface, Git or local method, operating system/shell, and desired plugins. Ask only for missing decisions; reuse the user's existing authorization.

Read this target's setup.json, manifest.json, and native registry. Use their actual marketplace identity, repository URL, available plugin IDs, versions, and skills. Do not borrow facts from another target.

A route marked needs-input is not executable guidance. Describe the missing procedure and ask for the user's demonstration or confirmation. Never guess app controls or treat a placeholder as evidence.
Inspect existing registrations and installed packages using supported read-only commands. Reuse a matching source and installed version. Explain conflicts before replacing anything.

Choose the declared shell variant. Run only the selected route and plugins, using automation output flags where provided. Interactive slash commands belong in the product, not the operating-system shell.
Keep authentication in the application's supported sign-in flow. Never ask for credentials in a prompt. Respect existing trust authorization; do not silently add automatic trust flags.
Preserve unrelated settings and working installations. Do not clear caches, remove unrelated packages, rewrite global configuration wholesale, or weaken permissions to make setup pass.
Verify installed identity, version, enabled state where exposed, and skill discovery. A zero exit code or copied files alone do not establish successful setup.
Start or request a fresh session when needed. Run a functional skill request only if the user authorizes that execution; installation does not require a model call.
Report the selected route, packages installed or reused, observed verification, and the next user action. Separate documented behavior, observations, and untested or blocked work.

troubleshooting.title: The terminal does not recognize the command
troubleshooting.reason: The application may be missing, unavailable in this terminal, or too old for plugin commands.
steps: Open a new terminal after installing the application.
Check its version and plugin help against the official command reference.
Do not paste interactive slash commands into the system terminal.
troubleshooting.expected: The application starts and its plugin commands or Plugins interface are available.

troubleshooting.title: The Git repository cannot be added
troubleshooting.reason: The URL, network connection, or Git access may prevent fetching the marketplace.
steps: Compare the source with the repository address in your selected guide.
Confirm access through your normal Git authentication flow; private repositories require access.
Retry after resolving access. Do not disable certificate checks or paste a token into the guide.
troubleshooting.expected: The intended marketplace is listed without an access error.

troubleshooting.title: The local folder is not recognized
troubleshooting.reason: Marketplace registration uses the repository root; direct plugin installation uses an individual plugin folder.
steps: For Codex or Grok registration, open the directory containing the marketplace registry and plugins folder.
For Antigravity terminal installation, select plugins/<plugin-id> inside that checkout.
Keep the existing checkout; do not delete it to retry registration.
troubleshooting.expected: The source is recognized and the desired packages are available.

troubleshooting.title: The plugin is installed but its skills are missing
troubleshooting.reason: The session may predate installation, the plugin may be disabled, or a skill may require explicit invocation.
steps: Check the plugin's installed and enabled state.
Start a fresh session and open the skill picker or the selected plugin's skill guide.
Check invocation and tool requirements. Installation does not grant extra tools or permissions.
troubleshooting.expected: Applicable skills can be discovered or explicitly invoked in the new session.

troubleshooting.title: Grok does not show a newly installed skill
troubleshooting.reason: Discovery output can distinguish an unloaded package from a skill requiring an explicit request.
steps: Check the plugin is enabled in /plugins, then start a new session.
Run the optional discovery command below and look for the selected plugin and its expected skill names.
If the package is present but a skill is not offered automatically, read its invocation requirements.
troubleshooting.expected: The applicable skill names appear, or an explicit-invocation requirement explains the difference.

troubleshooting.title: The same plugin is already installed
troubleshooting.reason: A matching installation can be reused; another source may create ambiguity.
steps: Compare the installed identity, source, and version with this guide.
For another version or source, follow the product's update procedure after deciding which source to keep.
troubleshooting.expected: The intended source and version are identified without removing unrelated registrations.
